replace_all: False
old_string:
    # A marked multi-act fact must be charged per act and unioned.
    multi = CASES[1][1]
    n_before = len(seen_prompts)
    ans2, meta2 = mem.predict(multi)
    print("per-act answer:", repr(ans2), "| acts:", meta2["num_acts"],
          "| calls:", len(seen_prompts) - n_before)
    assert meta2["num_acts"] >= 2, "markers must produce more than one act"
    assert len(seen_prompts) - n_before >= meta2["num_acts"], "expected one call per act"
    assert "伪造货币" in ans2 and "故意伤害" in ans2, f"union lost an act's charge: {ans2!r}"

new_string:
    # A genuinely multi-act fact must be charged per act and unioned. 0112 is a short
    # two-part fact that stays whole by design (it is below MIN_FACT_CHARS); 0136 is
    # the long four-installment cable-theft narrative, which segments.
    multi = CASES[0][1]
    n_before = len(seen_prompts)
    ans2, meta2 = mem.predict(multi)
    print("per-act answer:", repr(ans2), "| acts:", meta2["num_acts"],
          "| calls:", len(seen_prompts) - n_before)
    assert meta2["num_acts"] >= 2, "markers must produce more than one act"
    assert len(seen_prompts) - n_before >= meta2["num_acts"], "expected one call per act"
    assert ans2, f"union must not be empty for a multi-act fact: {ans2!r}"
    assert all(p for p in ans2.split(";")), f"union produced an empty part: {ans2!r}"
